task_request:
I am a science museum curator, and I want to build an immersive online exhibit for our "History of Human Space Exploration" display. Please create a scrolling web page with 5 illustrated chapters. Generate illustrations for each milestone: chapter_1.png for Sputnik 1957, chapter_2.png for Apollo moon landing 1969, chapter_3.png for the Space Shuttle era, chapter_4.png for the ISS, and chapter_5.png for a Mars colonization concept.

Create index.html with full-screen sections for each chapter, smooth scrolling with layered depth effects, text animations that reveal content as you scroll, a progress indicator bar, and responsive design for different screen sizes.

nodes.objective: Define a historically legible five-chapter illustration system for Sputnik 1957, Apollo 1969, the Space Shuttle era, the ISS, and a future Mars colony, with coherent color, typography-safe composition, aspect ratio, and narrative progression.

Generate five coherent, distinct milestone illustrations and save them exactly as chapter_1.png through chapter_5.png, with visual details appropriate to each period and generous safe areas for web text overlays.

Create index.html with five full-screen illustrated chapters, accurate milestone copy, smooth natural scrolling, layered depth effects, reveal animations, a progress bar, responsive mobile behavior, reduced-motion support, and local image references.

Open the site at desktop and mobile sizes, scroll through every chapter, verify all images, progress behavior, responsive layout and reduced-motion fallback, and report checks without modifying artifacts.
